svg.title: Dino Controller wiring using the original Freenove ESP32 board image
svg.desc: Original board pixels cropped at x1030 y117 width276 height556, enlarged 2x with nearest-neighbor. All labels remain outside the board image. UP26 DOWN27 RIGHT25 LEFT21 CLK32 DT33 SW23.

g.text: Original board image · USB at bottom
Order for this joystick is unverified.
ENC = encoder · JOY = joystick · Connect matching labels; colors do not indicate harness wire colors.
Disconnect USB before wiring. Encoder: 3V3 only. Joystick: passive contacts, no VCC. All GND terminals share ground.
